summary: This table presents a financial performance summary comparing key metrics for the periods ending September 30, 2025, and September 30, 2024. It includes revenues, cost of sales, gross profit, operating expenses, and net profit, among other financial indicators. Notably, revenues increased by 4.3%, while gross profit saw a growth of 4.6%. Operating profit and net profit also reflect positive trends, with net profit before non-controlling interests rising by 6.9%. The table highlights the growth percentages for each metric, indicating overall financial improvement year-over-year.
